hooks.label: CreateDevice: MIXED on T&L hardware, SOFTWARE fallback
hooks.assembly:
push edi
    mov edi, esp
    sub esp, 220
    mov [esp+212], edx
    mov ecx, [eax]
    push esp
    push 1
    push 0
    push eax
    call dword ptr [ecx+0x34]
    test eax, eax
    jl software
    cmp dword ptr [esp+196], 4294836480
    jb software
    mov eax, [ebp+0x1c]
    mov ecx, [eax]
    push dword ptr [edi+8]
    push dword ptr [edi+4]
    push 128
    push dword ptr [esp+224]
    push 1
    push 0
    push eax
    call dword ptr [ecx+0x3c]
    test eax, eax
    jl software
    mov [esp+216], eax
    mov ecx, [edi+8]
    push dword ptr [ecx]
    call 0x10097000
    mov eax, [esp+216]
    jmp created
software:
    mov eax, [ebp+0x1c]
    mov ecx, [eax]
    push dword ptr [edi+8]
    push dword ptr [edi+4]
    push 32
    push dword ptr [esp+224]
    push 1
    push 0
    push eax
    call dword ptr [ecx+0x3c]
created:
    mov esp, edi
    pop edi
    add esp, 8

hooks.label: Reset: restore the MIXED no-fog default
hooks.assembly:
push ebx
    mov ebx, eax
    push edx
    push eax
    mov ecx, [eax]
    call dword ptr [ecx+0x38]
    test eax, eax
    jl reset_done
    push eax
    push ebx
    call 0x10097000
    pop eax
reset_done:
    pop ebx

rule: VertexShaderVersion >= 1.0 -> MIXED, else or on failure SOFTWARE; MIXED only: FOGVERTEXMODE=LINEAR, FOGSTART=10000, FOGEND=20000 after CreateDevice/Reset
